description: ASN, boundary and provider visibility. Provider and organization data are shown only when they exist in the data; nothing is inferred.

panels.description: REAL DATA = at least one real exporter sent flows in the last 5 minutes. IDLE = real exporters known, but no recent flows (not proof of failure). NO REAL EXPORTER DATA = nothing from a real exporter in 24 h.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT multiIf(active > 0, 2, known > 0, 1, 0) AS s FROM (
     SELECT uniqExactIf(ExporterAddress, TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all')) AS active, uniqExactIf(ExporterAddress, (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all')) AS known
     FROM default.flows_1m0s WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)

panels.title: STATUS

panels.description: Distinct source ASNs (0 = unknown counts as one).

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(SrcAS) FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}'))

panels.description: Share of traffic with a public (non-private, non-lab) ASN on either side. 0 % is expected for the private lab.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * sumIf(Bytes*SamplingRate, (SrcAS != 0 AND NOT (SrcAS BETWEEN 64496 AND 65534) AND NOT (SrcAS BETWEEN 4200000000 AND 4294967294)) OR (DstAS != 0 AND NOT (DstAS BETWEEN 64496 AND 65534) AND NOT (DstAS BETWEEN 4200000000 AND 4294967294))) / greatest(1, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)), 1) FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}'))

panels.title: PUBLIC-ASN TRAFFIC

defaults.noValue: No data in the selected range

targets.rawSql:
WITH top AS (SELECT DstAS FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) GROUP BY DstAS ORDER BY sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) DESC LIMIT 6)
     SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) SECOND) AS time, multiIf(DstAS = 0, 'Private / Unknown ASN', DstAS BETWEEN 64496 AND 64511, concat('AS', toString(DstAS), ' (lab / documentation)'), DstAS BETWEEN 64512 AND 65534, concat('AS', toString(DstAS), ' (private)'), DstAS BETWEEN 4200000000 AND 4294967294, concat('AS', toString(DstAS), ' (private)'), concat('AS', toString(DstAS))) AS asn, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) AS bps FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) AND DstAS IN (SELECT DstAS FROM top) GROUP BY time, asn ORDER BY time

panels.description: Private / Unknown ASN = no ASN available (private or unrouted address). AS64496–64511 are documentation ASNs used by the lab. Organization names are not part of the enrichment data.

defaults.noValue: No traffic in the selected scope

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label AS ASN, round(bytes*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime))) AS Traffic, round(100*bytes/sum(bytes) OVER (), 1) AS Share FROM (
     SELECT multiIf(SrcAS = 0, 'Private / Unknown ASN', SrcAS BETWEEN 64496 AND 64511, concat('AS', toString(SrcAS), ' (lab / documentation)'), SrcAS BETWEEN 64512 AND 65534, concat('AS', toString(SrcAS), ' (private)'), SrcAS BETWEEN 4200000000 AND 4294967294, concat('AS', toString(SrcAS), ' (private)'), concat('AS', toString(SrcAS))) AS label, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) GROUP BY label)
   ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Top destination ASN

panels.description: Direction is derived from verified interface boundary metadata: External → Internal = enters through an external interface. "Unclassified" = neither side is marked external. Nothing is guessed.

defaults.noValue: No data in the selected range

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) SECOND) AS time, multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'External → Internal', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'Internal → External', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'External → External', 'Unclassified') AS direction, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) AS bps FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) GROUP BY time, direction ORDER BY time

panels.title: External vs internal

defaults.noValue: Provider classification pending — appears when interfaces carry provider metadata.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT InIfProvider AS Provider, InIfConnectivity AS Type, ExporterName AS Exporter, round(sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime))) AS Traffic FROM default.${res}
     WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) AND InIfProvider != '' GROUP BY Provider, Type, Exporter ORDER BY Traffic DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT replaceAll(toString(DstCountry), '\0', '') AS Country, round(sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime))) AS Traffic FROM default.${res}
     WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) AND DstCountry != '' GROUP BY Country HAVING Country != '' ORDER BY Traffic DESC LIMIT 5
